description: The AAS journals' class, AASTeX 7.0.1 (CTAN's copy, in case the mirror's snapshot predates it). Its preamble (round 2 of batch 1, GitHub run 41584963423) redefines three of the class's footnote macros, copied from the pinned aastex701.cls with two changes. (1) \make@footnotetext (l.527-541) adds \vadjust{\vskip\z@skip} after the footnote's last line only in horizontal mode. footnotehyper, which General's footnotes load, releases its saved notes through the class's \@footnotetext with \@makefntext, \@finalstrut and \rule emptied, so the \vadjust came after \unvbox in internal vertical mode: 'You can't use \vadjust in internal vertical mode' in every General footnote (F19: 1,547 not-denied branches, 1,179 failing on nothing else; 16 cells ended at TeX's 100-error stop). In horizontal mode, where every footnote of the class's own path ends, it is unchanged. (2) \@makefntext (l.7567-7569) and \@mpmakefntext (l.6209-6215, footnotes in floats and minipages) take paragraphs (\long), as the kernel's and revtex4-2's aps4-2.rtx \@makefntext do: General's block footnotes stopped at 'Paragraph ended before \@makefntext was complete' (F31: 596 branches; F49: 114 more, whose runaway argument ran to the end of the file). A footnote without a paragraph break sets as before. (3) The class's preamble builder relaxes \@endpbox, \do@row@strut and \ar@align@mcell (b22, owner item JR2-2), as array's own \@mkpream does (array.sty 2026/02/24 v2.7b l.432-434) and the class's older \@mkpream@array did (l.1376). aastex701 loads array itself (l.8716) and at \begin{document} swaps in revtex4-2's copies of its internals (\switch@array, l.760, l.883-955); their \@mkpream@array@new (l.1401-1454) calls \@mkpream@relax (l.1366-1373, 1455-1463), which relaxes \@startpbox but not \@endpbox. array adds each p-column with \xdef (\@addtopreamble, array.sty l.55), so the class's \@endpbox (\@finalstrut\@arstrutbox\color@endgroup\egroup\hfil, l.8721) was expanded while the preamble was built, and the kernel's \color@endgroup (\endgraf\ifvmode\@endpefalse\fi\endgroup, latex.ltx l.16353) tested the mode then: in vertical mode \@endpefalse expands the conditional \if@endpe inside the \xdef, which takes the \fi of \ifvmode, so the \or ending the p-column case raised 'Extra \or' (...\@endpbox \do@row@strut \or) and every later \or of \@mkpream's \ifcase repeated it until TeX's 100-error stop. In the GitHub run every tabularx begun in vertical mode (General's tables at the top level, in a [H] table, first in a statement, in vwcol's measuring \parbox) stopped there: 317 aastex cells, 21 of 21 such tables reached with no earlier error in a sample of 75 aastex.A cells, while 27 of 27 begun after \leavevmode or \noindent built cleanly (in the horizontal mode \ifvmode skipped \@endpefalse). Relaxed, \@endpbox stays a token in the preamble and runs in its cell, as in every class that loads array, so the build no longer depends on the mode, and tabularx and colortbl stay fit here though revtex4-2 refuses them for the same swap. A cell that ends in vertical mode (General's cells end with \par) now ends as array ends it: \@finalstrut takes back the line its strut starts (\vskip-\baselineskip) instead of leaving a blank line at the cell's foot. (4) A third line (b22, owner item revtex O1, interim until Flouest's contents provide the name themselves) gives article's \contentsname, \listfigurename and \listtablename, which aastex701, like revtex4-2 whose code it copies, never defines (its titles are \tocname, \lofname and \lotname, l.6657-6659), and makes its titles print them, so General's renamed contents and tocloft's titles (\cfttoctitlename is \contentsname) find them; the titles print as before unless renamed. Floats begun in a paragraph (b23, ERRORS LTXGRID-FLOAT): aastex701's \end@@float (ltxgrid's, aastex701.cls l.3640-3656) adds a float begun in horizontal mode (\@floatpenalty -10002, latex.ltx's \@xfloat) through \vadjust, and a float that ended in vertical mode stopped at 'You can't use \vadjust in vertical mode' (GitHub run r2-461ed0e: 19 failing not-denied branches in each pair, floats after \leavevmode in a list or statement inside a statement, e.g. d6c1d4df72e826e832679 l.145; all pass under article.A). The copy here adds such a float to the column directly, as one begun between paragraphs, when it ends in vertical mode; in horizontal mode it is as before. A float that ends in internal vertical mode (inside a box) was lost after the error and is lost without it (GitHub probe 41775212344, ERRORS-aastex-vadjust: its sentinel still never ships). Since b24 (OVFA-AASARRAY) a further line keeps the array package's own tabular: aastex701 does not recognise array 2.6+ ('Class aastex701 Info: Unrecognized array package ... Proceeding with fingers crossed') and its document hook still installs its copies (\switch@array, l.760 and l.883-960), under which every tabular of a block starts with one interword space per source line of the table (b23 probe OVFBLOCK-diag-tpt-aastexA, main.log l.1662-1690: 11 glues of 3.087pt before \mathon in an 11-line threeparttable, 33.95706pt over; 17 of 3.33pt in awesomebox's, 37.74pt over); the copies also replaced colortbl's own definitions ('colortbl package is loaded. (Proceeding with fingers crossed.)'). GitHub run r3-7771790: 37.74pt in 626 and 33.95706pt in 180 not-denied aastex.A/B rows, all failing; the same blocks pass under article. GitHub probe b24-all (OVFA-aas-tpt and OVFA-aas-awesome, -old against -new): with this line the 33.95706pt and 37.74pt boxes are gone, no TeX error is added, the same sentinels ship and none is outside the text block any more. The 11.36781pt box (General's tabularx in a General footnote, 538 rows) has another cause: OVFA-aas-fntabx-new keeps it. With \switch@array \relax the class's own \tabular@hook and \endtabular@hook still wrap LaTeX's tabular (l.761-767), and the class's longtable copy (\LT@array@new, installed by \switch@longtable, not by \switch@array) still calls \@mkpream@relax after array's own \@mkpream (l.4880-4881), so the earlier \@mkpream@relax line still applies to longtables. Batch 4 round 1: that \let\switch@array\relax also took away the class's own array copies that deluxetable relies on, and every AASTeX deluxetable stopped at 'Missing } inserted' at \enddata (tbl.class-env@deluxetable and @deluxetable-wide passed 0 of 79 branches per setup; aastex.A document d7cf8e2cccd9b91ad21c7, result 45d1f59978, l.554). The line now saves the original as \compat@aas@switch@array and runs it at the start of deluxetable and deluxetable* only (env/…/begin hooks), so the b24 tabular fix stays everywhere else (local probe, compat cases: deluxetable, deluxetable*, a \startlongtable deluxetable* and a p-column tabular after a deluxetable all compile; a tabular in a minipage in \fbox has no overfull box).
